teaser: Every piece you built now clicks together into six enterprise patterns: sandboxed workers, policy gateways, approval queues, specialists and more.
takeaways: Enterprise patterns are design patterns built on SDK features, not SDK features themselves.
Pick the single fitting control: hooks for always-on policy, permission callback for human approval, sandbox for blast-radius limits.
Sandboxed worker per task uses cwd, permission modes and disallowed_tools; never use bypassPermissions outside isolation.
Subagents isolate context but lose it in hand-offs and multiply cost; resumable jobs persist session ids and must not double-count cost.
